earlystage-founders-building-saas-and-ai.headline: Early-Stage Founders Building SaaS \u0026 AI Tools - Built From Scratch
earlystage-founders-building-saas-and-ai.description:
Looking for founders building something from scratch\
\
I’m looking to talk to a few founders who are currently building a startup, SaaS, AI tool, or any kind of online business.\
\
I’m putting together a bi-weekly series called Built From Scratch, where we follow real founders and show what building a business actually looks like — not just the polished success story.\
\
I’d love to hear about things like: \
What you’re building \
Why you started it \
How you got your first users \
Your current MRR/revenue (if you’re comfortable sharing) \
What’s working \
What’s completely not working \
Your biggest challenge right now \
What you’re trying to accomplish next\
\
At the end, we’ll give the business a Launch Score based on things like traction, growth, product, and potential.\
\
If you’re currently building something and would be interested in being featured, drop your startup below and tell me what you’re building

employees-hiding-knowledge-from-workplac.headline: Employees Hiding Knowledge From Workplace AI - Want Pay For AI Data
employees-hiding-knowledge-from-workplac.description:
Companies are running out of data to train AI, and to patch the gap, they are turning to their own workers, recording precisely how they use their computers, including mouse clicks and keystrokes. Is your employer doing the same? Have you found yourself gatekeeping your knowledge in response? \
\
For a story for The Guardian, I'm looking to speak to people who are now hiding their knowledge from workplace AI systems and wish workplaces would better reward employees for AI data. DM me, or you can email me at [email redacted]! \
\
#journorequest #sourcerequest #AI #AIdata #workplaces #AItraining

enterprise-ai-leaders-ai-governance-and-.headline: Enterprise AI Leaders - AI Governance \u0026 Agent Sprawl
enterprise-ai-leaders-ai-governance-and-.description:
Most enterprises don't have an AI strategy. They have an AI sprawl problem dressed up as one- Hundreds of agents. Dozens of models. Zero unified visibility into what they're doing, what they're consuming, or what they cost.\
 \
After 21 years in enterprise technology, I firmly believe this is a defining infrastructure problem of the AI era.\
 \
And most organizations won't realize it until a compliance audit, a security incident, or a budget review forces the conversation. The question keeping enterprise leaders up at night has shifted.\
